summary: The filing is a routine current report on Form 8-K by the issuing entity BANK 2022-BNK40 reporting a change in special servicer for one of its mortgage loan assets (Journal Squared Tower 2 Mortgage Loan, ~9.4% of the pool). Under the trust and servicing agreement (WFCM 2022-JS2 TSA), Situs Holdings was removed and Torchlight Loan Services was appointed as successor special servicer, effective July 7, 2026. No terms, premium, or recommendation. This is a standard administrative servicing update with no structural event.
